name: Minstrel
ability: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
interaction: None; after a Minion dies by execution, all non-Traveller players except the Minstrel are drunk until dusk of the next day.
drunk_or_poisoned: If the Minstrel is drunk or poisoned when the Minion dies, nothing happens.

jinxes.text: If Legion died by execution today, Legion keeps their ability, but the Minstrel might learn they are Legion.

rulings.text: Does not trigger on a Minion's night death, on executing an already-dead Minion, or on an executed Minion that survives.
Traveller exile or execution does not trigger it; Travellers are not made drunk.
The Minstrel is not made drunk by their own ability.
A Zombuul executed for the first time while everyone is drunk has no ability and dies, so good wins.

test_scenarios.name: minion executed
test_scenarios.setup: 5 players: 1 Minstrel, 2 Imp, 3 Poisoner, 4 Chef, 5 Empath.
test_scenarios.expected: Seats 2, 4 and 5 are drunk until dusk of day 2; night 2 Imp kill fails and nobody dies.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned minstrel
test_scenarios.setup: 1 Minstrel, 2 Imp, 3 Poisoner, 4 Scarlet Woman, 5 Chef, 6 Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1 Poisoner poisons seat 1; day 1 seat 4 executed.
